name: Simply Asia
src: Simply Asia allergen and nutrition schedule (Allergens-Menu-2024.pdf, dated August 2024), per dish as served. Calories as published; kilojoules are worked out. Allergens as marked in the schedule (it covers sesame). Changes to a dish ("Rice to ...", "NO VEG"), plain vegetable ingredients and the 6-piece combo platter are left out; sodium over 8,000 mg for one dish is a misprint and left blank. Left out 3 row(s) whose calories don't match their macros: Extra Calamari (with sauce) (97 kcal vs 23 from macros); Scoop of Ice Cream (127 kcal vs 226 from macros); Extra Seafood (with sauce) (97.2 kcal vs 53 from macros).
